title: Kingsway Learning Center students taken to hospital after school bus crash in East Greenwich Township, New Jersey
text:
Kingsway Learning Center students taken to hospital after school bus crash in East Greenwich Township, New Jersey - 6abc Philadelphia 
 24/7 Live Philadelphia Pennsylvania New Jersey Delaware Bus Crash 
 2 students taken to hospital after school bus crash in East Greenwich Twp., Gloucester County 
 Two students were taken to the hospital after a school bus was involved in a crash with a truck in East Greenwich Township WPVI By 6abc Digital Staff Tuesday, November 3, 2026 5:45PM Share Follow 6abc on Google EAST GREENWICH TWP., N.J. (WPVI) -- Two students were taken to the hospital after a school bus was involved in a crash with a truck in East Greenwich Township Tuesday morning.
 It happened just after 7 a.m., near Kings Highway and East Wolfert Station Road in Gloucester County, New Jersey.
 Chopper 6 over crash involving school bus in Gloucester County 
 Officials say a small school bus and a truck collided, causing the bus to roll over several times.
 Chopper 6 was over the scene, where you could see "Holcomb" on the side of the bus.
 Chopper 6 over crash involving school bus in Gloucester County. 
 The bus was carrying four occupants, including two students attending Kingsway Learning Center in Voorhees, as well as the driver and another adult.
 One student is in the 5th grade and one in the 10th grade, police say.
 Both students were evaluated at the scene by Gloucester County EMS on the scene and transported to Cooper University Hospital for further evaluation. Their injuries are believed to be non-life-threatening.

 The adult passenger on the bus was also evaluated and transported to Cooper University Hospital with non-life-threatening injuries.
 The driver of the school bus and the driver of the pickup truck both declined medical attention at the scene.
 Both the truck and bus have significant damage.
 Chopper 6 over crash in Gloucester County 
 The cause of the crash remains under investigation. No charges have been filed at this time.
 Anyone who witnessed the crash or has information that may assist investigators is asked to contact the East Greenwich Township Police Department at (856) 423-4322.
